environment.description: Flask application deployed as a Kubernetes pod in namespace 'payments' on a cluster running Istio 1.19 with permissive mTLS mode. The Istio sidecar is injected but no AuthorizationPolicy resources exist. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP service on port 8080. Any pod in any namespace can reach the /api/v1/debug/* endpoints directly through the mesh. No NetworkPolicy is applied.
